ops.title: Which cc-transcript Python modules become native-backed facades vs stay Python (v14 P6 deletion sweep), and the events-in &Entry-borrow binding recipe

ops.body:
The v14 P6 deletion sweep converts Python reference modules to thin facades over the native (`_native`) core: the Python COMPUTATION dies, compute runs native, Python keeps only the public typed dataclass surface + docstrings (the `mining/engine.py` rehydrate pattern).

**KEY CORRECTION (learned mid-sweep):** the intuition "native is path/raw-based, so already-parsed in-memory events can't route to native" is FALSE. `mine_events` proves the pattern: `rust/crates/py/src/mining.rs::view_entry(&Bound<PyAny>) -> &Entry` borrows the `&Entry` behind each materialized Python view (views hold Arc refs into the parsed buffer) — NO serialization. So an **events-in native binding** is: a py fn taking `Vec<Bound<PyAny>>`, mapping `mining::view_entry` → `Vec<&Entry>`, running core over the borrowed slice. If core takes `&[Entry]` (owned), add a `&[&Entry]` borrowed-slice entry point and delegate (see notifications `from_entry_refs`, buckets `bucket_events_refs`). Regen the stub in the SAME commit (byte-gate: `cargo run -p cc-transcript-py --bin stub_gen` then `cargo test --workspace`).

CONVERTED to native facades: command.py (native view classes + `CommandLine.parse`), cost.py (`cost_of_json`), facts.py (`tool_facts`, path-based), context.py capture (`context_capture_window`, raw+anchor), render.py raw renderers (`render_*`); and via events-in bindings — filterspec POST-PARSE leg (`keep`/`apply_spec`/`labels_for`/`annotate_spec` → `keep_events`/`label_events`; core `spec_labels` + `CompiledClause.action/label` added), notifications.py (`from_events` → `notifications_from_events`), sentiment/buckets.py (`ConversationBucketer.bucket_events`/`extract_bucket_keys` → `bucket_events_from_events`; facade rehydrates via a `(session_id, uuid)` map). backend.py deleted.

STILL SURVIVES Python: activity.py/query.py (rich `Turn.events`/`ToolUse.call` structuring over native parse+toolcall_parse_view — stay by USER DECISION for v14; the rich-view Rust port was declined; load-bearing for evidence.py). filterspec's FilterSpec/Clause dataclass tree + `spec_to_json` (the parse-time builder) + the public `_RE` regex exports + text helpers (`interrupt_marker`/`is_agent_injection`/`embedded_user_text`) — those are str-based, not events, so `keep_events` doesn't cover them. mining/filterspec (filters `FeedbackCandidate`, not events), mining/formats (callable-driven extraction, inherently Python), mining/sampling (rich-activity orchestration). render.py's rich `render_turn`/`render_session`/`render_tool_call`.

LOC landed ~9,000 (from 10,185; not the 4–4.5k target — living code stays). Runtime deps dropped: click/aiosqlite/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-bash (0 consumers); anyio→dev extra; orjson STAYS (parser + spec serializers + models.ReadOnlyDict). See [[cc-family-v8-release-mechanics]] and [[cc-transcript-build-env]].
